maddeler.e:
تتراضوا (form VI)
# تَتَرَاضَوْا (tatarāḍaw) /ta.ta.raː.dˤaw/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of تَرَاضَى (tarāḍā)
# تُتَرَاضَوْا (tutarāḍaw) /tu.ta.raː.dˤaw/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of تَرَاضَى (tarāḍā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
